description: For the runner of recurring work: register or update a job and report one step of a run (working at the start, then done, partial, failed, deferred or skipped). A failed run opens a failure that stays on the owner's Teams page until a later run of the same slot is done, or someone marks it fixed. Maintainers of the job's space only.

allowTerms.description: Words you confirm are not private names

at.description: ISO time it happened, when replaying history (default now)

fixes.description: With done: earlier slots this run makes good

key.description: Job key, unique in its space, like site.daily-review

nextDue.description: ISO time the next run is expected; shown as overdue after it plus the grace

paused.description: The job is switched off for now

slot.description: The scheduled occasion, like 2026-11-25 or daily:2026-11-25:14

state.description: working, done, partial, failed, deferred or skipped

title.description: Readable name (required when the job is new)

name: report_job
title: Report a scheduled run
